name: tierstore-site
description: The tierstore.dev web site: pages prerendered by a build program, a little script, no runtime dependencies

scripts.test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && node --test build/tools/test/*.test.js
scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && node build/tools/tools/build.js
scripts.golden: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && node build/tools/tools/manifest.js
